title: Truth was here before your urgency
summary: Truth stands before beginning, through time, and beyond this heated moment. Urgency loses authority when it is measured against what was already true.
takeaway: Measure urgency against the Truth that was here first.
lifeApplication: Before reacting, say the line about Truth before time and let your next move become smaller, slower, and more obedient to Hukam.

source.shortMeaning: Truth precedes the urgency trying to rule this moment.
source.lifeApplication: Before reacting, remember that Truth did not begin with this scene.
